sample_data.method: Fixture embedded directly in data.js at build time, sourced from the organizer-supplied P08_school_results_public.json
sample_data.reset_instructions: Reload the page — data.js is static and re-parses the original fixture on every load, so there is no mutable state for judges to reset.

problem_solving_method: We separated the grading rules from presentation: engine.js implements per-subject grade points, the GPA formula, and the compulsory-failure override as pure functions, while app.js/data.js handle loading the fixture and rendering the trace and checking-list UI. We validated against the full 25-case public dataset (1,765 students), not just the first case, and specifically hand-recomputed the four required hard-edge cases (high-average compulsory fail, practical fail with passing theory, absence, optional below the help threshold) against the engine's output before trusting the rest.

REQ-1.evidence: data.js embeds the organizer-supplied fixture (25 cases, e.g. PUB-01 has 80 students across Class 9 and Class 10). All four named hard-edge cases are present and verified in the dataset (see README 'Proof requirements are met'). SCREENSHOT PLACEHOLDER

REQ-2.evidence: engine.js: evaluateSubject(), evaluateStudent(), evaluateCase() compute per-subject grade points, final GPA, and letter grade. SCREENSHOT PLACEHOLDER

REQ-3.evidence: app.js openTrace()/subjectRow(): per-subject trace table showing mark used, grade point, and the deciding rule; failing compulsory subjects get a red-pen circle annotation and a '← caused the fail' label so a high-average failure is traceable to its cause. SCREENSHOT PLACEHOLDER

REQ-4.evidence: app.js renderTabs()/renderTable(): three list tabs (Optional-Subject List, Practical-Fail List, Absent List) driven by engine.js evaluateCase().lists, each with a plain-language reason per student. SCREENSHOT PLACEHOLDER

REQ-5-clarifications.evidence: engine.js: GRADE_BANDS, THEORY_PASS/PRACTICAL_PASS constants, GPA formula with 5.00 cap and compulsory-failure cancellation, R-29 checking-list definitions implemented exactly as specified. SCREENSHOT PLACEHOLDER

team_members.major_contribution: Prepared and structured the GitHub repository, set up GitHub Pages deployment, and handled submission logistics (EVENT.md, repository settings, final push).
Built the application: prompted, reviewed, and iterated on the grading engine and UI with Claude, and verified the generated code against the brief's rules.

Quality assurance: tested all four required hard-edge cases against the live app, cross-checked the checking lists and trace output against the fixture data, and verified the requirement-by-requirement proof in the README.
Documentation: wrote/reviewed README.md, LICENSES.md, and evaluation-manifest.json, and captured the screenshots used as evidence.

major_design_decisions: Used the standard Bangladesh SSC grade-band table (A+ 80-100=5.00 down to F 0-32=0.00) since the brief specified pass marks and the GPA formula but not the mark-to-grade-point table itself; isolated to one constant (GRADE_BANDS) in engine.js.
Any compulsory-subject failure forces GPA 0.00/F, but the uncancelled average is still computed and shown in the trace so a high-average student's cause of failure is visible, not hidden.
Fixture is embedded directly in data.js rather than fetched at runtime, so the app works over file:// with zero server setup.
known_limitations: Requires internet access on first load to fetch Google Fonts (Source Serif 4, IBM Plex Mono, Inter, Kalam); the app still functions with system fallback fonts if fonts.googleapis.com is unreachable.
No automated unit-test suite beyond a single headless-browser smoke test (smoke_test.js); correctness was verified by inspection and by cross-checking on-screen stats against the engine's own output.
data.js embeds all 25 fixture cases inline (~430 KB) for zero-server file:// compatibility; this is larger than a fetched JSON file would be over the wire.

ai_tools_used.used_for: Drafting and iterating on the grading engine (engine.js) and report UI (app.js/data.js) logic against the brief's rules and clarifications (R-10 through R-29).
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Manually recomputed GPA and grade points by hand for representative students covering all four required hard-edge cases, and cross-checked the on-screen checking lists against the fixture data directly.
